name: cloud-itonami-kagi
comment: shadow-cljs compiles src/kagi/itonami/worker.cljs -> dist/worker.js, served at app.itonami.cloud/kagi through itonami-fleet-dispatch. dds.css is inlined at compile time. @noble/hashes is here because kagi.digest's :cljs branch takes SHA-256 from it, and kagi.ledger's chain check is that hash.
